title: 第十七章 碾压天才第十八章 长老临凡
content_zh:
楚浩一身白衣翻飞，筑基后期的磅礴灵气彻底铺开。
空气被压得发沉，四周街边的碎石、尘土，尽数被无形气劲卷得微微震颤。
身为青岚宗内门最拔尖的年轻天才，他有足够高傲的资本。
常年浸泡宗门最优渥的资源，修炼正统高阶功法，打过秘境妖兽、战过同辈无数，实战经验远不是李奎那种外门养老执事能比的。
在他看来，自己出手，已经是给足了这布衣散修脸面。
“嘴硬无用。”
楚浩眼神冷冽，脚步一踏。
身形瞬间窜出，速度比昨日李奎快了不止一档。
掌风凝实厚重，灵气压缩得极致内敛，没有花哨声势，全部力道浓缩于一掌之间。
青岚宗内门绝学——青岳掌。
掌势沉、落点狠、破防强，专门压制同阶修士的护体灵气。
他根本没打算试探，出手即是杀招。
目标直指烬孤宸胸口道台位置。
只要一掌震乱对方道基、打散灵气，这所谓的完美筑基妖孽，立刻就会沦为废人。
街边所有围观之人，心脏瞬间提到嗓子眼。
太快了！
不愧是内门天才，这速度、这力道，比昨日李奎强出数倍！
很多人下意识觉得，结束了。
布衣少年再强，终究只是筑基初期，越级打赢外门执事已是极限，不可能抗衡真正的内门筑基后期。
面对扑面而来的沉猛掌势，烬孤宸站在门槛上，半步未退。

眼神平静得过分。
楚浩的招式很快、很标准、很正统。
但在他眼里，依旧满是破绽。
功法是好功法，修为是高修为，可人心浮躁、傲气过盛、发力急躁。
高手对决，急躁就是死穴。
就在掌风即将贴身的瞬间，烬孤宸终于动了。
没有蓄力，没有起手式。
身子微微一侧，简简单单避开掌锋。
同时抬手，指尖并拢，顺势一斩。
动作极短、极快，干净得几乎看不见轨迹。
噗！
灵气凝于指尖，薄如刀锋，精准划过楚浩手腕经脉。
正在全力催功的楚浩，只觉得手腕骤然一麻。
整条手臂的灵气瞬间断档、滞涩！
蓄满全身的掌力，一瞬间衔接不上，硬生生卡在半空。
招式破！
content_en:
Chu Hao's white clothes were flying, and the majestic spiritual energy in the late stage of foundation building was completely spread out.
The air was so heavy that the gravel and dust on the surrounding streets were all shaken slightly by the invisible energy.
As the most outstanding young genius within the Qinglan Sect, he has enough pride.
He has been immersed in the sect's most abundant resources all year round, practicing orthodox high-level skills, fighting secret realm monsters, and fighting countless peers. His actual combat experience is far beyond that of an outside sect pension deacon like Li Kui.
In his opinion, by taking action, he had already given this commoner Sanxiu face.
"It's useless to talk harshly."
Chu Hao's eyes were cold and he stepped forward.
The figure jumped out instantly, and his speed was more than one level faster than Li Kui yesterday.
The wind in the palm is solid and thick, and the spiritual energy is compressed extremely restrained. There is no fancy sound, and all the strength is concentrated in one palm.
Qinglan Sect's inner sect's secret skill - Qingyue Palm.
The palm is heavy, the landing point is ruthless, and the defense is strong. It is specially designed to suppress the body-protecting aura of monks of the same level.
He didn't intend to test it at all, it was his ultimate move.
The target was pointed directly at the platform on Jin Guchen's chest.
As long as one palm shakes the opponent's Dao foundation and disperses the spiritual energy, this so-called perfect foundation-building monster will immediately become a useless person.
The hearts of all the people watching on the street suddenly rose to their throats.
Too fast!
He is truly a genius in the inner sect. His speed and strength are several times stronger than Li Kui’s yesterday!
Many people subconsciously feel that it is over.
No matter how strong the commoner boy is, he is only in the early stage of foundation building. It is his limit to defeat the deacons of the outer sect by leapfrogging, and it is impossible to compete with the real inner sect in the later stage of foundation building.
Facing the fierce palm attack coming towards him, Jin Guchen stood on the threshold without even taking a step back.
His eyes were too calm.
Chu Hao's moves are fast, standard and orthodox.
But in his eyes, it was still full of flaws.
The exercises are good and the cultivation is high, but people are impetuous, arrogant and impatient.
In a duel between masters, impatience is the Achilles heel.
Just when the palm wind was about to close to his body, Jin Guchen finally moved.
There is no charge, no starting position.
Turn your body slightly to one side, simply avoiding the palm.
At the same time, he raised his hand, brought his fingertips together, and slashed with the force.
The movements are extremely short, extremely fast, and so clean that the traces are almost invisible.
puff!
The spiritual energy condensed on the fingertips, as thin as a blade, and accurately cut through the meridians of Chu Hao's wrist.
Chu Hao, who was exerting all his strength, felt his wrist suddenly go numb.
The spiritual energy of the entire arm suddenly stopped and became stagnant!
The palm power accumulated all over the body was unable to connect for a moment, and it was stuck in mid-air.
The move is broken!
